summary: General business details: name, logo, contact, tax ID and currencies.
purpose: It's the first thing to set up. The name and logo show on quotes, invoices, reminders and the patient portal; the main currency is the one for prices and the cash register.
tips: If you have more than one branch, the address goes on each branch and not here.
Changing the main currency doesn't convert prices already entered.

config.clinics.field.clinic-logo.label: Logo
config.clinics.field.clinic-logo.description: Image shown on printed documents and on the patient portal.

config.clinics.field.clinic-location.label: Address
config.clinics.field.clinic-location.description: Only visible with one branch or none; with several, each branch has its own.

config.clinics.field.clinic-currency.label: Main currency
config.clinics.field.clinic-currency.description: Currency for prices, quotes and the cash register.

config.clinics.field.clinic-secondary-cu.label: Secondary currency
config.clinics.field.clinic-secondary-cu.description: Optional: another currency you also charge in (the conversion is shown).

config.clinics.btn.add-sede.label: Add branch
config.clinics.btn.add-sede.description: Creates a branch without leaving this screen.
